Package org.uma.evolver.meta.encoding.parameter

Class TreeVariationParameter

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.parameter.Parameter<String>
org.uma.evolver.parameter.type.CategoricalParameter
org.uma.evolver.parameter.catalogue.variationparameter.VariationParameter<DerivationTreeSolution>
org.uma.evolver.meta.encoding.parameter.TreeVariationParameter
public class TreeVariationParameter extends VariationParameter<DerivationTreeSolution>
Variation parameter for derivation tree solutions (DerivationTreeSolution). The only supported strategy is crossoverAndMutationVariation, combining the conditional crossover and mutation parameters; the offspring population size is taken from the non-configurable sub-parameter offspringPopulationSize.
